description: Run tailored mock interviews from a resume or LinkedIn profile and a job description, with adaptive follow-ups and evidence-based coaching.

defaultPrompt: Start a voice-first mock interview tailored to my background and a specific job opening.
Help me practice a tough hiring-manager interview for a job I'm applying to.
Run a behavioral mock interview and give me candid feedback at the end.
interface.longDescription: Prepare in text, rehearse in voice where supported, and leave with a practical improvement plan. Provide a resume or LinkedIn profile and a job description using native attachments, links, or pasted text. Interview Rehearsal verifies available sources, analyzes role fit, offers a recommended setup, and conducts one-question-at-a-time interviews calibrated to role, seniority, and stage. Includes adaptive follow-ups, evidence-based feedback, targeted retries, and transfer questions to test improvement. Works across professions and experience levels. Users enable host voice mode themselves; text remains fully supported. Uses available host browsing and file tools with readable-text fallbacks; no separate server or guaranteed hiring predictions.

name: interview-rehearsal
